data.title: Fine notice: mobile phone use while driving (€128.50)
data.summary: The central fines office (Zentrale Bußgeldstelle) of Regierungspräsidium Musterbergen issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 5 November 2025 for holding a mobile phone while driving on 14 October 2025. The total to pay is €128.50, plus 1 point in the driving register.
data.explanation: You are accused of holding a mobile phone while driving. The fine is €100, plus €25 fees and €3.50 delivery costs, and 1 point is recorded. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines office; it must arrive there within the period shown, counted from delivery on the envelope. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and you then have two weeks to pay, quoting the file number. Otherwise the fine can be enforced. If unsure, consider legal advice.
data.case_title: Fine notice for phone use while driving, October 2025
